rows.note: Use 搖搖板 as the all-purpose term for the playground apparatus.

example.english: The children lined up to play on the seesaw at the park.
example.traditional: 小朋友喺公園排隊玩搖搖板。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 paai4 deoi2 waan2 jiu4 jiu4 baan2

rows.note: Use 起伏 for general up-and-down changes, including changes in feelings or conditions.

example.english: My mood has been on a big seesaw lately, happy one moment and unhappy the next.
example.traditional: 我最近嘅情緒起伏好大，一時開心，一時唔開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 ge3 cing4 seoi5 hei2 fuk6 hou2 daai6 jat1 si4 hoi1 sam1 jat1 si4 m4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use 此消彼長 when one side or tendency increases as the other decreases.

example.english: In the market, it is a seesaw between the two companies: when one gains, the other loses.
example.traditional: 市場上兩間公司此消彼長，一間得益，另一間就受損。
example.jyutping: si5 coeng4 soeng6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ci2 siu1 bei2 zoeng2 jat1 gaan1 dak1 jik1 ling6 jat1 gaan1 zau6 sau6 syun2
